summary: A missing 60-year-old male construction worker was reported from a site at Tarryall; he was located several miles away by the sheriff after a 9/9-10/19 search.
responding_agency: Search and Rescue Dogs of Colorado (SARDOC); Park County Sheriff's Office
notes: SARDOC 2019 public mission summaries (opened run 598): 'Missing 60 y/o male construction worker from site. Located several miles away by Sheriff.' Date 9/9-10/19; incident date set to 2019-09-09.
